title: Trove medication
description: One line of health/medical/<source>/medications/YYYY-MM.jsonl: a prescribed, reported, or filled medication (FHIR MedicationRequest / MedicationStatement, Blue Button Part D claim, or a parsed pharmacy PDF). Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local authored / fill date, or a date-only YYYY-MM-DD when that is all the source gives

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

guid.description: source-unique id, the dedupe key: FHIR resource id, EOB id, or ndc+date+prescriber

code.description: terminology code (RxNorm coding.code, or the dispensed NDC)

code_system.description: which system the code is from: "rxnorm" | "ndc" | …

prescriber.description: prescriber, as a display name (FHIR requester.display)

start.description: validity/effective period start (RFC3339 local or date-only)

end.description: validity/effective period end (RFC3339 local or date-only)

extra.description: everything source-specific (days supply, quantity, route, full resource)
